subject: Request: temporary log retention waiver for debugging (PraxisHealth)
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@praxishealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carter Graves <c.graves@securitypartners.io>
Date: Sun, 3 Aug 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request for temporary SOC 2-aligned log retention waiver for debugging

Hi Sean —

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. We're close to a production cutover, but our SREs hit a recurring issue where short-lived inference traces (30–90s) that would normally be discarded are needed for an ongoing root-cause analysis tied to a customer incident.

Praxis's security team requested we ask Redwood for a temporary retention waiver that would allow retention of request/response traces and debug logs for specific tenant IDs for up to 90 days (from the current 7-day default) and for a limited set of time windows. We understand this is non-standard so: 1) we will provide exact tenant IDs and time ranges, 2) agree to scoped access controls, and 3) accept audit/attestation evidence when the data is destroyed.

Can you confirm what artifacts Redwood needs (SIG/SOC2 support docs, proposed access controls, a signed waiver) and whether your team is open to a one-off retention extension under contractual terms? I attached a short request summary.

Thanks,
Olivia Chen
Director, Platform Security — PraxisHealth

Attachment: Praxis_SIG_Retention_Request.pdf (summary request, 2 pages)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@praxishealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for temporary SOC 2-aligned log retention waiver for debugging

Olivia —

Appreciate the clear ask and the summary PDF. Short answer: we can support a scoped, timeboxed retention extension for debug traces, but it requires approvals from Security and Legal and a small operational playbook so that we don't weaken tenant isolation.

To move this along, could you confirm:
- Exact tenant IDs and the earliest event timestamp you need preserved
- Whether you need token-level content or just metadata + KV cache snapshots
- A proposed retention window (you mentioned up to 90 days) and whether staged deletion is acceptable (e.g., expedited purge after postmortem)

From Redwood's side we will provide:
- A proposed waiver template (I attached our standard retention-waiver-template)
- A list of required SOC 2 / SIG artifacts and evidence (what our Security team will evaluate)
- Operational controls: RBAC for access, time-limited keys, and an attestable purge runbook

Looping in Kimberly to scope the security evidence and Marissa for customer coordination. I'll follow up after Security returns the targeted checklist.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Sr. Customer Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-retention-waiver-template.docx (internal waiver template)

Subject: Re: Request for temporary SOC 2-aligned log retention waiver for debugging

Team —

Thanks for looping me in. I reviewed Praxis's attached summary and drafted a minimal evidence checklist for an internal approval gate. High level: we can approve a tenant-scoped retention extension provided the following controls and artifacts are in place before we sign off:

Required from Praxis (pre-approval):
- Tenant IDs and justification (business+security)
- Confirmation that only named Praxish engineers will request access and that RBAC will be enforced
- Completed SIG-lite answers to the retention section (I referenced which questions we need)

Redwood commitments (pre-approval):
- Retention limited to specified tenant IDs and trace types (request/response, KV cache snapshots)
- Read access logged to a dedicated audit stream and limited to a named service account
- We will produce an attestation of deletion after the retention window

Operational constraints I want on the waiver:
- Maximum window: 90 days (no auto extensions)
- Single approval cycle per retention window, no rolling exceptions without re-approval
- Forensics access only via a documented request/approval workflow (email to security + CS)

Markus — can Legal review the template and confirm any contractual language we should require (indemnities, data handling specifics)? I recommend adding a clause that Praxis must cover any costs of extended storage and that Redwood be allowed to sample the deleted records for verification in our secure enclave prior to issuance of the deletion attestation.

-Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Director, Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 6 Aug 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for temporary SOC 2-aligned log retention waiver for debugging

Kimberly / Sean —

I reviewed Kimberly's proposed controls and redlined the waiver template. Legal is comfortable with a one-off retention waiver under the following conditions:

1) Praxis signs the waiver and acknowledges that Redwood's standard SOC 2 policies remain in force;
2) Praxis agrees to bear incremental storage costs (we'll estimate based on provided tenant IDs);
3) The waiver includes an explicit destruction attestation and a sealing period during which Redwood may keep a cryptographic hash of destroyed objects for audit (no payload retention);
4) Any access to extended data must be audited and limited to named personnel;

I added language to the template to require a joint postmortem and an agreed scope for any forensic exports. If Praxis agrees, Legal will prepare a short addendum that can be signed electronically (DocuSign).

-Markus
Markus Klein
Associate General Counsel — Redwood Inference
